skill: Edit FIRST animation sprite sheet using SECOND approved character design. Preserve all six poses, the exact heads attached to necks and moving with the torso, face, body, hands, leg lunges, skirt motion, six frames in 3 columns x 2 rows and their placement. Make ONE targeted correction only: remove the LARGE CURVED BROWN/IVORY HORNS and gigantic crescent brackets around the floating ring that were accidentally borrowed from the realistic motion references. Replace these with the approved design's FOUR TINY IVORY SPIRIT PRONGS, each only 1-3 native pixel squares long: one small prong at either side of head, one small prong at either side of waist, following the body. The approved ring is a compact flat jade oval, not a dragon sculpture. Keep the same 14-pixel bob/head silhouette, short bare brown legs, navy gold-top boots, white wrap, violet outfit and pink hem, magenta eyes. No effects or glow, no floating head, no head pasting. Exactly preserve the full-body animation. Transparent background; pure crisp pixel art, same palette as design, no anti-aliasing, no grid or text.
